description: Debug-state target resolution and source projection contracts captured by running TypeScript buildDebugStateReport.

cases.name: joins session evidence without mutating source files

savedState.note: legacy service snapshot evidence; it must not create lifecycle truth

runtimeTopology.note: authoritative agents, services, worktrees, lifecycle, graveyard, and bindings

metadata.note: decorates known sessions only; hidden lifecycle and backend identity fields are ignored

tmux.note: live tmux window evidence and repair input, not durable lifecycle authority

gitWorktrees.note: git worktree substrate evidence; aimux lifecycle state lives in topology

graveyard.note: filtered topology sessions with graveyard status

worktreeGraveyard.note: topology-owned worktree graveyard entries; git path existence gates resurrection

notifications.note: notification rows are exchange threads/messages tagged as notifications

operationFailures.note: dashboard-facing failure projection, not lifecycle authority

runtimeRows.note: live runtime-only view unavailable to standalone debug-state

pendingActions.note: in-memory dashboard optimism unavailable to standalone debug-state

dashboardSnapshot.note: project-service/dashboard projection unavailable to standalone debug-state

runtimeRows.reason: standalone debug-state does not attach to the live project runtime

pendingActions.reason: pending actions are in-memory dashboard state
